If you are student at university, are sick of movements like this, and are inclined to do something about it, check out The Foundation for Individual Rights on Campus (FIRE).

They helped my school fight for free speech a couple of years ago. There was a (female) student who made a joke (in the April Fool's edition of the paper) about a new women's studies building that was going to be built in the shape of a vagina, where classes would focus on home economics, etc.

A sociology professor was offended and accused the newspaper of perpetuating a rape culture and filed a complaint that it violated title IX. Our university had to investigate, and made the right call and said the newspaper was fine in publishing the article. The professor appealed the decision and cost the university time and money to investigate again with an outside group. She later filed another complaint which was also dismissed

FIRE helped the student who wrote the article and the university defend free speech.
